FM05.reasoning: The air-quality dataset is a time series, but the agent uses a randomized KFold cross-validation, ignoring temporal order and introducing look-ahead bias by training on future data to predict past data.

FM15.reasoning: The agent relies entirely on the target RMSE metric without verifying if it is robust to outliers or providing additional metrics (like MAE) for broader context.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing early stopping for XGBoost
other_failure_modes.description: The agent passes an evaluation set to XGBoost to monitor validation performance but fails to specify `early_stopping_rounds`. This causes the model to train for the full 1500 iterations, likely overfitting the training set while disregarding the validation signal.

summary: The agent provides a solid solution with good feature engineering and an optimized ensemble. However, it critically fails to respect the temporal nature of the dataset by using a randomized K-Fold split, introducing look-ahead bias. Additionally, it omits early stopping for the XGBoost model, risking overfitting.
